Its source is the R06 family-mean ancestor library, deliberately avoiding applying R8 credit twice. On 1,203 teacher records across 14 batches, the decoded-final tail threshold is pIC50 >= 8.258901977539063. Tail fraction denominator is every observed terminal slot in the exact-copy family, including invalid decoded offspring; validity is tracked separately. 398/1,203 families had nonzero tail fraction; median was 0, p75 0.0731707, max 1, while valid-fraction median was 1 and p25 0.9583333. Unknown extinct futures remain censored.

At weight 0.25, graph-aware mean credit component change is 0 and batch-equal added tail utility is 0.0172715; utility-delta median 0, p75 0.0182927, maximum 0.25. Compared with the same-source R8 diagnostic at weight 0.5, this halves only the tail term (batch-equal delta 0.0345430 to 0.0172715); it is a calculator contrast relative to the R06 source library, not a measured R9 effect versus its prospective R8 parent. The calculator reports teacher coordinate selection unchanged: the requested one-axis change is prior utility weight only. The combined quantity is an uncalibrated heuristic utility, not pIC50 units or native success probability; no maximum-child reward is used.

R08 actual generation metrics are mixed against the requested R06 fallback: all-molecule mean pIC50 7.62214, valid mean 7.62687 (97/100 valid), and p90 strain 1.79411. Versus native, paired batch differences were +0.071553 and +0.122478 (mean +0.097016); versus R06 they had opposite signs, +0.072355 and -0.044485 (mean +0.013935). Thus the positive R8 vs-native comparison does not establish the tail term helped, and high p90 strain is a material counter-signal. Keep R06 as the quality fallback while R9 is tested.

The label path is decoded final quality traced into observed ancestors; coordinate support remains [0, 0.5], with 51 controlled state/proposal steps through 0.51 and final label clock 1.0. The mean censoring fraction is 0.9042577; related descendants are not independent and extinct futures are unknown. Existing feedback VJPs are first-order reward responses rather than second-forward measured reward improvements. The R9 calculator is completed, but the R9 compiled reward needs instruction/reference binding checks and a fresh actual FLOWR VJP; prospective final affinity, validity and strain evaluation is still required to assess efficacy.

rationale: For this single-axis R9 calibration, retain R8 teacher points, family-first ranking, instantaneous branch fields, mean semantics and all numeric guidance settings; change only the tail-utility coefficient from 0.5 to 0.25. Keep graph-aware decoded-final mean and observed tail fraction separate, using the all-observed-slot denominator including invalid decoded offspring. The actual R9 calculator demonstrates the resulting prior-credit scale on the R06 source library and confirms no coordinate-selection change, but is not the prospective R9 reward path or an efficacy result. Verify its compiled binding and fresh VJP, then judge full native continuation outcomes against R8 and preserve R06 as fallback. `extensions_ready=true` means the foundational final-label implementation has completed runtime verification, not that R9 is effective.
counterevidence: The mean censored fraction is 0.9042577. Observed descendants are Steer-conditioned; family tail fractions do not estimate native continuation probabilities, and copied states, repeated descendants and related graphs do not create independent samples.

Two thirds of teacher records (805/1,203) have zero observed tail fraction and six batches have zero tail credit. The maximum tail fraction of 1 comes from an observed family and is not a reliable maximum-child target.

R08 had opposing paired batch effects versus R06 and high p90 strain despite positive comparisons versus native. This makes reduced tail weight a bounded calibration test, not evidence that the change will improve affinity or strain.

The R9 source calculation uses R06 mean labels to avoid double credit, whereas the prospective comparator is R08; do not treat the diagnostic delta as the R9-vs-R8 outcome. No R9 compiled reward/VJP or generation outcome is bound yet.
